news.title: 4th Circuit dismisses some charges against Wells Fargo after jury’s $22.1M fee
news.summary: Although the appeals court dismissed three or four charges following a worker’s disability trial, in affirming the fourth charge, it allowed him to retain most of his award.

news.title: New York Times presses EEOC for White bias records in FOIA lawsuit
news.summary: The media giant alleged the agency has dragged its feet and ignored the Times’ inquiries about when its requests for information will be met.

news.title: What mentorship looks like in the disconnected era
news.summary: Successful mentorship programs are often guided but not too structured and don’t rely on managers being default mentors, experts told HR Dive.

news.title: Healthcare costs could rise by nearly 10% in 2027
news.summary: Employers cover more than 80% of the burden, but employees will also be hit by rising costs, an Aon report found.

news.title: Looks matter more than resume in first impressions, study says
news.summary: “People want to think that they are making really high-level analytical decisions based on effectively evaluating evidence,” but that’s not what is happening, one professor said.

news.title: United’s retention of harassing pilot may have been criminally negligent, judge finds
news.summary: The airline allegedly learned of a police investigation into a pilot’s distribution of a worker’s intimate images in April 2024 but didn’t act until his arrest later that year.

news.title: Feds to propose H-1B fee that would stack with controversial $100K payment
news.summary: Employers should expect litigation against the new fee once it is finalized, a source told HR Dive, similar to what occurred after last year’s fee was announced by President Donald Trump.

news.title: EFAA covers claims that emerge during an arbitration proceeding, 9th Circuit says
news.summary: The parties in the case conducted arbitration proceedings for a full year — but that fact alone can’t prevent plaintiffs from seeking arbitration exemption, the court held.

news.title: Companies that roll back DEI don’t perform better financially, study says
news.summary: “Large corporations appear to have folded under pressure for no financial gain,” a public policy scholar wrote.

news.title: Week in review: Bank of America bans consecutive remote days
news.summary: We’re rounding up last week’s stories, including HR Dive’s summer reading list for 2026.
